entries.title: Update 2.61.0.17
entries.description: A bug that sometimes caused the game startup after logging in to take much more time than usual has been fixed.

entries.title: War Thunder "Eagle's Shadow" - Changelog
entries.description: Eagle’s Shadow introduces a comprehensive selection of vehicles, ranging from the modern Leopard 2A8 equipped with the Trophy APS and the Second World War Fulmar Mk.II with 8,000 rounds of ammunition, to the F-15EX featuring excellent armament options and the Su-15TM equipped with the newly added R-98 missiles.

entries.title: Server Update 30.10.2026
entries.description: Battle Ratings that were different to the final table from the planned Battle Rating changes have been corrected.

entries.title: Update 2.59.0.92
entries.description: The Planned Battle Rating changes have come into effect.

entries.title: Update 2.59.0.87
entries.description: A bug where vehicles in battle were sometimes not locked for respawn if their last destruction was counted as a crash or leave kill has been fixed. This issue could have occurred after using a backup vehicle or exhausting the tournament respawn limit.
